findings.description: Nit: In harness-report.schema.json, the 'then' schema for state='ready' asserts 'cli_on_path: true' and 'config_present: true', but does not constrain 'config_artifact' to be a non-null string ('type: string, minLength: 1'), unlike the 'state=config_missing' clause at lines 130-139.
findings.resolution: Add 'config_artifact': { 'type': 'string', 'minLength': 1 } to the 'then' block for state='ready' in harness-report.schema.json.

findings.description: The creation of legacy_shim.py transcribing lines 211-232 of SKILL.md into executable Python for TDD parametrization (Design D7) is an excellent pattern. It ensures all 4 settings-writer defects are proven reproducible in code prior to writing the fix.

Selecting atomic_write_bytes instead of atomic_write_json (Design D2) accurately identifies that canonical_json_bytes would re-sort keys and break indentation preservation on .claude/settings.local.json, avoiding a regression of defect #2.
